_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: It means, it is okay, do not worry.
Sorry, I am late. No problem!

native.caption: हर बात पर बस “Okay” बोलते हैं? अब कहिए “No problem.”, यानी कोई बात नहीं। उदाहरण: “Sorry, I am late.” – “No problem!” Ama टीचर को सुनिए और ख़ामोशी में दोहराइए। Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.caption: Do you only say “Okay” to everything? Now say “No problem.”, which means do not worry. Example: “Sorry, I am late.” – “No problem!” Listen to teacher Ama and repeat in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
